checks: later file completes first in running application; reports, stores, headers, conflict candidates, records and source rows equal fixed serial baseline; children have no QApplication
cancel stops new submissions, waits/reaps readers, discards completed payloads, blocks overlapping recheck and stale updates
retry after cancel succeeds; mixed invalid/valid file reports and normalized rows equal serial baseline
all-failed check shows unchanged error and keeps prior results invalid
close during reading cancels/reaps children before closing and retains original unsaved-work confirmation
fresh window after close can check again; single-file path has no child process
